characters.description: A silver-rank adventurer and commander whose developing Soul Realm holds captive messengers. He leads efforts to protect Yoresh's survivors while seeking the astral knowledge needed to finish a bridge to Earth.
characters.name: Jason Asano

characters.description: An Earth outworlder, natural-array specialist, and magitech engineer. She works with Travis on long-range magical communications and supports Jason's team with expertise drawn from repairing Earth's magical grid.
characters.name: Farrah Hurin

characters.description: An astral-magic researcher and ritual specialist in Jason's team. He studies captured messenger magic in hopes of making its principles usable and advancing the unfinished bridge to Earth.
characters.name: Clive Standish

characters.description: A defender and team leader who protects Jason's group and is prepared to use both combat ability and family standing against political pressure.
characters.name: Humphrey Geller

characters.description: A fast-moving striker in Jason's team and Melody's daughter. She supports the group while seeking a safe way to help her mother, whose imposed magical faith has left her unstable.
characters.name: Sophie Wexler

characters.description: An infiltrator and tactical specialist in Jason's team. She contributes covert methods, battlefield judgment, and a practical eye for unconventional solutions.
characters.name: Belinda Callahan

characters.description: The healer and combat-support member of Jason's team. He travels with the group, treats the injured, and supplies defensive support during dangerous operations.
characters.name: Neil Devone

characters.description: A veteran adventurer and mentor within Jason's circle. He brings training, experience, and steady support to a group facing threats far beyond ordinary contract work.
characters.name: Rufus Remore

characters.description: A Leonid smith and frontline defender allied with Jason. His forging strengthens the team, while his practical skill and physical power make him valuable in both construction and battle.
characters.name: Gareth Xandier

characters.description: An Earth outworlder and aerial combatant allied with Jason. He supports the team while hoping its work will eventually provide a route home.
characters.name: Taika

characters.description: Jason's shadow familiar, serving as scout, messenger, and ethical counterweight. Shade gathers information where possible and challenges Jason when fear or anger threatens his judgment.
characters.name: Shade

characters.description: Jason's familiar and combat avatar, most often operating as a life-draining swarm.
characters.name: Colin

characters.description: Jason's eye familiar, providing ritual support and delivering his afflictions through spreading butterflies.
characters.name: Gordon

characters.description: Clive's rune-tortoise familiar, used as transport and a protective shelter for the team. Onslow can also absorb elemental energy, making him valuable in magically hostile terrain.
characters.name: Onslow

characters.description: A healer, death mage, and trusted confidante of Jason. She supports his recovery and approaches prisoners and magically injured people with care informed by trauma.
characters.name: Arabelle Remore

characters.description: A healer-researcher focused on bodies and souls changed by unusual magic. His work offers possible routes to understand altered victims without assuming that dangerous changes can be safely reversed.
characters.name: Carlos Quilido

characters.description: Sophie's mother, physically remade and conditioned by an imposed faith. The conflict between that influence and her original mind leaves her unstable and potentially dangerous to herself.
characters.name: Melody Jane

characters.description: Jason's gold-rank aura mentor. Their similar spiritual injuries give them unusually forceful and sensitive auras, and Amos investigates messenger techniques that may help Jason control his nonstandard abilities.
characters.name: Amos Pensinata

characters.description: A gold-rank treasure hunter allied with Jason. He and Constance pursue the missing relic associated with Purity and its ability to cleanse corrupted cores.
characters.name: Amir Bahadir

characters.description: Amir's gold-rank wife and partner. She works beside him in the continuing search for Purity's missing core-cleansing relic.
characters.name: Constance

characters.description: A captive messenger commander who describes his changed condition and that of the other prisoners as freedom from Astral King control.
characters.name: Marek Nior Vargas

characters.description: A silver-rank messenger captive in Jason's realm who awakens to find that her Astral King brand and advancement limit are unexpectedly gone.
characters.name: Terra June Castor

characters.description: An Adventure Society liaison with administrative and logistics expertise. He manages the difficult flow of information between Jason's team and institutions that do not fully trust them.
characters.name: Vidal Ladiv

characters.description: An unnamed diamond-rank Adventure Society negotiator who offers Jason a reset in relations. She proposes cooperation on the coming crisis without requiring him to surrender every secret about his messenger prisoners.
characters.name: Adventure Society Diamond-Rank Negotiator

characters.description: An Earth outworlder and large-scale magitech engineer. He works with Farrah on a long-range communications network combining Earth technology with local magic.
characters.name: Travis

characters.description: A former princess of the Storm Kingdom travelling as Zara Noreen under her mother's family name.
characters.name: Zara Rimaros

characters.description: The messenger leader who proposes an alliance over the unstable natural array. Conflicting accounts within her own forces leave the true purpose of the excavation uncertain.
characters.name: Messenger Voice of the Will

characters.description: A gold-rank civic official responsible for external affairs. He accuses Jason of misconduct, then chooses to test Jason's portal despite a warning about its unusual power.
characters.name: Calcifer Bynes

characters.description: A leading figure in a wealthy aristocratic faction seeking bureaucratic control over the rebuilding of Yoresh. He is Calcifer Bynes's father.
characters.name: Gormonston Bynes

characters.description: A gold-rank Leonid representing the Adventure Society's Continental Council. He arrives in Yoresh to confront a culture that treats Society membership as inherited status instead of a duty to serve.
characters.name: Marcus Hargrave Zenoria

characters.description: A silver-rank messenger sent to deliver the device needed for the underground expedition. Bound by an Astral King mark, she privately questions the hierarchy she outwardly serves.
characters.name: Silver-Rank Messenger Envoy

characters.description: A gold-rank adventurer, Arabelle's husband, and Rufus's father. His unexpected arrival reunites the family as he joins the dangerous underground expedition.
characters.name: Gabriel Remore

characters.description: A diamond-rank Adventure Society leader overseeing the investigation into the attack on Jason. She reports that local aristocrats arranged the attempt through intermediaries and supports interrogating and trying the captured attacker.
characters.name: Lady Eliath

characters.description: A gold-rank stealth and assassination specialist who attacks Jason after previously kidnapping him for starseed implantation. He faces interrogation, trial, and likely execution.
characters.name: Lawrence Sparnow

characters.description: Leader of Team Moon's Edge. She questions whether intelligence supplied through Jason's messenger captives is reliable enough to guide the expedition.
characters.name: Miriam Vance

characters.description: A gold-rank member of Team Moon's Edge whose decision to withhold help while testing Jason endangers vulnerable researchers.
characters.name: Valetta

characters.description: Leader of the surviving Builder cultists beneath the natural array. He calls Jason the Defier and seeks an alliance against the elemental messengers because his own people need a path to survive.
characters.name: Beaufort

characters.description: A Brightheart who proposes preserving a defensible minority but intends to remain with the civilians when that plan is rejected.
characters.name: Marla

characters.description: The sole surviving Brightheart councilwoman, leading the last people of Cardenas. She refuses to preserve only a defensible minority when the rest of the population faces extinction.
characters.name: Lorraine

characters.description: A god who claims the souls of three captured enemy agents. Destruction prevents Amos from questioning them and kills the prisoners by detonating their bodies.
characters.name: Destruction

characters.description: A goddess who assures Jason that Beaufort genuinely seeks cooperation to keep his people alive. She prompts Jason to consider creating and directing a transformation zone.
characters.name: Knowledge

characters.description: A captured messenger and astral-magic technician who claims links to both the Unorthodoxy and an Earth-based Cabal. He offers to operate and adapt the captured messenger device while warning that his Astral King brand will soon regain control.
characters.name: Boris

characters.description: A divine counter to the expanding undeath incursion. She answers Jason's plea for aid but demands a sacrifice greater than the stored resurrections he first offers.
characters.name: Death

characters.description: A god whose miracle turns a willing champion into a vessel of divine power for a limited time. Hero offers Gary the strength to help hold the Citadel wall.
characters.name: Hero

characters.description: An incomplete divine vessel deployed against the Citadel. The Avatar suppresses Gary's protection across the wider battlefield and attacks the wall with massive chained harpoons.
characters.name: Avatar of Undeath
